$comment: Swarm, 2: the team checks in, the lead splits the task into parts, and each part is built and reviewed in its own thread.
do: eval:(() => { const c = document.querySelector('[data-testid="thread-conversation"]'); if (!c) return; let n = c; while (n && !/(auto|scroll)/.test(getComputedStyle(n).overflowY)) n = n.parentElement; if (!n) return; const go = () => n.scrollTo({ top: n.scrollHeight, behavior: 'smooth' }); go(); new MutationObserver(go).observe(c, { childList: true, subtree: true }); })()
caption:The team checks in|Each member says which part it would take.
caption:The lead splits the task|One part for each member.
caption:Every part is a task with its own thread
click:text="Export endpoint that streams orders as CSV"
